title: Exact functor on an Ext cocycle representative
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with Ext groups [def-pc-ext], L:C→D an additive exact functor, A,B objects of C, A′ an object of D, and α:A′→L(A). Let R and R′ be injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of B and L(B). Suppose φ:L(R)→R′ is a cochain-complex map for which L(ι_R);φ is homotopic to the augmentation ι_R′ after the canonical single-complex comparison. For q≥0 and a:A→R^q with a;d_R=0, set a′=α;L(a);φ^q and suppose a′;d_R′=0. Then the Ext class represented by a′ in R′ equals Ext.mk₀(α) composed with L applied to the Ext class represented by a in R. This is a formula for individual cocycles, without a statement about Hom-complex homology or a map of quotient groups.

source.place: Lemma 13.27.2(1), roof description of Ext; functoriality as in Tag 01F8 and equations 01F9/01FA

proof.text: Use Mathlib extEquivCohomologyClass_symm_mk_hom and Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom to express both sides as derived-category roofs. ShiftedHom.comp_map and map_naturality_2 transport the mapped numerator through mapDerivedCategoryFactors; the single-complex comparison identifies its source.

Apply DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_of_homotopy to the given augmentation homotopy. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv and cancellation of the invertible mapped augmentation give factors.inv(R);mapDerivedCategory(inv(Q(ι_R)));singleComparison.hom(B) = Q(φ);inv(Q(ι_R′)). This is a direct equality of localized morphisms, requiring no bijectivity theorem for maps into K-injectives.

Check the numerator at degree zero by HomologicalComplex.from_single_hom_ext. The component formulas for Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm, fromSingleMk, and mapHomologicalComplex show it is exactly α;L(a);φ^q. Transport this equality with ShiftedHom.map and combine it with the denominator equality. Ext.hom injectivity closes the claim. All formulas also hold for q=0 and zero α or a.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 13.27.2(1); functoriality of roofs as in Tag 01F8, implemented using Mathlib Ext.Map and DerivedCategory.ExactFunctor

lean.statement:
theorem ext_mapExactFunctor_cocycle
    {C : Type w} {D : Type w'} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{v} C] [HasExt.{v} D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) [L.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    {A B : C} {A' : D} (α : A' ⟶ L.obj A)
    (R : InjectiveResolution B) (R' : InjectiveResolution (L.obj B))
    (φ : (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj R.cochainComplex ⟶ R'.cochainComplex)
    (hφ : Nonempty (Homotopy
      ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map R.ι' ≫ φ)
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex L (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app B ≫ R'.ι')))
    (q : ℕ) (a : A ⟶ R.cochainComplex.X (q : ℤ))
    (ha : a ≫ R.cochainComplex.d (q : ℤ) ((q : ℤ) + 1) = 0)
    (ha' : (α ≫ L.map a ≫ φ.f (q : ℤ)) ≫
      R'.cochainComplex.d (q : ℤ) ((q : ℤ) + 1) = 0) :
    (Ext.mk₀ α).comp
      ((R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm
        (.mk (Cocycle.fromSingleMk a (zero_add (q : ℤ)) _ rfl ha))).mapExactFunctor L)
      (zero_add q) =
    R'.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm
      (.mk (Cocycle.fromSingleMk (α ≫ L.map a ≫ φ.f (q : ℤ))
        (zero_add (q : ℤ)) _ rfl ha'))
